item.title: FIM – Linux framebuffer image viewer
item.description:
📝 An internal scripting language specialized for image viewing allows image navigation, scaling, manipulation of internal variables, command aliases, and Vim-like autocommands. This man page describes fim command line options and usage. Regard this as another easter bunny option.
🔗 Read more: https://www.nongnu.org/fbi-improved/

item.title: PROBoter – Open-source platform for automated PCB analysis
item.description:
📝 The PROBoter’s main features are:A hardware platform that provides automated probing with up to four independent probes. A click-and-probe software solution that utilizes the hardware platform for automated PCB image generation, visual analysis and (semi-)automated probing. In this first part of the PROBoter blog post series the main idea behind the platform and basic concepts of embedded system security analysis are presented.
🔗 Read more: https://www.schutzwerk.com/en/blog/proboter-01/

item.title: How Big Tech wrote secrecy into EU law to hide data centres' environmental toll
item.description:
📝 How Big Tech wrote secrecy into EU law to hide data centres’ environmental toll | Investigate EuropeHow Big Tech wrote secrecy into EU law to hide data centres’ environmental toll17 April 2026Nico SchmidtElla JoynerCredit: SpoovioHow Big Tech wrote secrecy into EU law to hide data centres’ environmental tollCredit: SpoovioNico SchmidtElla Joyner17 April 2026ENEnvironmental footprint of Europe's data centres kept secret after industry lobbying in a move legal experts warn could violate transparency rulesMicrosoft and DigitalEurope, a lobby group whose members include Amazon, Google and Meta, secured a secrecy provision in EU law to block public access to critical information on data centres’ environmental impact, Investigate Europe can reveal. The final text of Article 5 requires “the Commission and Member States concerned [to] keep confidential all information and key performance indicators for individual data centres. Such information shall be considered confidential information affecting the commercial interests of operators and owners of data centres.
🔗 Read more: https://www.investigate-europe.eu/posts/big-tech-data-centres-secrecy-eu-law-environment-footprint
